arxiv-2005-00064.title: Randomized greedy algorithm for independent sets in regular uniform hypergraphs with large girth
arxiv-2005-00064.creator: Jiaxi Nie, Jacques Verstraëte
arxiv-2005-00064.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Jiaxi Nie, Jacques Verstraëte. In this paper, we consider a randomized greedy algorithm for independent sets in r r -uniform d d -regular hypergraphs G G on n n vertices with girth g g .

arxiv-2011-13908.title: Group-level Fairness Maximization in Online Bipartite Matching
arxiv-2011-13908.creator: Will Ma, Pan Xu, Yifan Xu
arxiv-2011-13908.description: Abstract We consider the allocation of limited resources to heterogeneous customers who arrive in an online fashion. We would like to allocate the resources “fairly”, so that no group of customers is marginalized in terms of their overall service rate.

arxiv-2105-09682.title: Tensionless Tales: Vacua and Critical Dimensions
arxiv-2105-09682.creator: Arjun Bagchi, Mangesh Mandlik, and Punit Sharma
arxiv-2105-09682.description: Abstract Recently, a careful canonical quantisation of the theory of closed bosonic tensionless strings has resulted in the discovery of three separate vacua and hence three different quantum theories that emerge from this single classical tensionless theory. In this note, we perform lightcone quantisation with the aim of determination of the critical dimension of these three inequivalent quantum theories.

arxiv-2110-07743.title: On the objectivity of measurement outcomes
arxiv-2110-07743.creator: Elias Okon
arxiv-2110-07743.description: Abstract Recent arguments, involving entangled systems shared by sets of Wigner’s friend arrangements, allegedly show that the assumption that the experiments performed by the friends yield definite outcomes, is incompatible with quantum predictions. From this, it is concluded that the results of measurements cannot be thought of as being actual or objective.

arxiv-2211-11629.title: PVT++: A Simple End-to-End Latency-Aware Visual Tracking Framework
arxiv-2211-11629.creator: Bowen Li, Ziyuan Huang, Junjie Ye, Yiming Li, Sebastian Scherer, Hang Zhao, Changhong Fu
arxiv-2211-11629.description: Abstract Visual object tracking is essential to intelligent robots. Most existing approaches have ignored the online latency that can cause severe performance degradation during real-world processing. Especially for unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs), where robust tracking is more challenging and onboard computation is limited, the latency issue can be fatal.

arxiv-2306-09702.title: A Hierarchical Bayesian Model for Deep Few-Shot Meta Learning
arxiv-2306-09702.creator: Minyoung Kim, Timothy Hospedales
arxiv-2306-09702.description: Abstract We propose a novel hierarchical Bayesian model for learning with a large (possibly infinite) number of tasks/episodes, which suits well the few-shot meta learning problem. We consider episode-wise random variables to model episode-specific target generative processes, where these local random variables are governed by a higher-level global random variate.

arxiv-2309-08391.title: Fractional Advection Diffusion Asymmetry Equation, derivation, solution and application
arxiv-2309-08391.creator: Wanli Wang, Eli Barkai
arxiv-2309-08391.description: Abstract The non-Markovian continuous-time random walk model, featuring fat-tailed waiting times and narrow distributed displacements with a non-zero mean, is a well studied model for anomalous diffusion. Using an analytical approach, we recently demonstrated how a fractional space advection diffusion asymmetry equation, usually associated with Markovian Lévy flights, describes the spreading of a packet of particles.

arxiv-2408-00740.title: Matched Guiding and Controlled Injection in Dark-Current-Free, 10-GeV-Class, Channel-Guided Laser Plasma Accelerators
arxiv-2408-00740.creator: A. Picksley, J. Stackhouse, C. Benedetti, K. Nakamura, H. E. Tsai, R. Li, B. Miao, J. E. Shrock, E. Rockafellow, H. M. Milchberg, C. B. Schroeder, J. van Tilborg, E. Esarey, C. G. R. Geddes, A. J. Gonsalves
arxiv-2408-00740.description: Abstract We measure the high intensity laser propagation throughout meter-scale, channel-guided LPAs by adjusting the length of the plasma channel on a shot-by-shot basis, showing high quality guiding of 500 TW 500\text{\,}\mathrm{T}\mathrm{W} laser pulses over 30 cm in a hydrogen plasma of density n 0 ≈ 1 × 10 17 cm − 3 n_{0}\approx$1\text{\times}{10}^{17}\text{\,}\mathrm{c}\mathrm{m}^{-3}$ .

arxiv-2504-03803.title: What Large Language Models Do Not Talk About: An Empirical Study of Moderation and Censorship Practices
arxiv-2504-03803.creator: Sander Noels, Guillaume Bied, Maarten Buyl, Alexander Rogiers, Yousra Fettach, Jefrey Lijffijt, Tijl De Bie
arxiv-2504-03803.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as gateways to information, yet their content moderation practices remain underexplored. This work investigates the extent to which LLMs refuse to answer or omit information when prompted on political topics. To do so, we distinguish between hard censorship (i.e., generated refusals, error messages, or canned denial responses) and soft censorship (i.e.

arxiv-2505-10723.title: Mesh Stability Guaranteed Rigid Body Networks Using Control and Topology Co-Design
arxiv-2505-10723.creator: Zihao Song, Shirantha Welikala, Panos J. Antsaklis, Hai Lin
arxiv-2505-10723.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Zihao Song, Shirantha Welikala, Panos J. Antsaklis, Hai Lin. Merging and splitting are of great significance for rigid body networks in making such networks reconfigurable. The main challenges lie in simultaneously ensuring the compositionality of the distributed controllers and the mesh stability of the entire network.

arxiv-2508-01113.title: On the contact type conjecture for exact magnetic systems
arxiv-2508-01113.creator: Lina Deschamps, Levin Maier, Tom Stalljohann
arxiv-2508-01113.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Lina Deschamps, Levin Maier, Tom Stalljohann. In this article, we answer—for a broad class of magnetic systems—a question posed by Contreras, Iturriaga, Paternain, and Paternain [ 21 ] in 1998, now known as the contact type conjecture . To this end, we explicitly construct, on any closed manifold , an infinite-dimensional space of exact magnetic systems, which we introduce here as magnetic systems of strong geodesic type .

arxiv-2508-15426.title: Algebraic description of the triaxially to axially rotational shape phase transition
arxiv-2508-15426.creator: Yu Zhang, Yu-Xin Liu, Feng Pan, J. P. Draayer
arxiv-2508-15426.description: Abstract Within the framework of the interacting boson model, we propose a novel algebraic scheme to describe spin-dependent structural evolutions in triaxial nuclei. Our analysis demonstrates that a triaxially to axially rotational shape phase transition can be induced by the high-order correction which is microscopically motivated by the pairing interaction on the γ \gamma -unstable rotation.

pmc-13107091.title: Tabernaemontana catharinensis: A Source of Indole Alkaloids With Potential Activity as Chemotherapeutic Agents
pmc-13107091.creator: Ana Júlia Gomes Donada, Rafael Freitas Corá, Bianca Canci, Mariana Roesch‐Ely, Pauline Fagundes Rosales, Sidnei Moura
pmc-13107091.description: This study aimed to evaluate the antitumor activity of fractions rich in indole alkaloids extracted from the leaves of the species Tabernaemontana catharinensis. The chemical composition was analyzed using high‐resolution mass spectrometry (HRMS), which identified nine known indole alkaloids, including voacangine, voacangine hydroxyindolenine, ibogamine, and affinisine.

pmc-13277549.title: Base excision repair in chromatin: A tug-of-war for DNA damage
pmc-13277549.creator: Abigayle F Vito, Daniel J Boesch, Ava M Hammons, Bret D Freudenthal, Tyler M Weaver
pmc-13277549.description: Base excision repair (BER) is a genome surveillance pathway responsible for repairing DNA base lesions distributed throughout the chromatinized eukaryotic genome. However, chromatin structure acts as a dynamic structural barrier that restricts access to DNA and must be overcome for BER to proceed efficiently.

pmc-13342418.title: Seeing through the veil: blue-light filtering and peak contrast sensitivity in pseudophakic patients
pmc-13342418.creator: Jacob B. Harth, Lisa M. Renzi-Hammond, Spencer F. Smith, Billy R. Hammond
pmc-13342418.description: PurposeAtmospheric short-wave scattered light (blue haze) limits visual range by reducing the contrast of distant objects. While theoretical models and prior research suggest that filtering short wavelengths can improve visual range, significant individual differences persist in tolerance to veiling luminance, even among individuals with similar ocular health and acuity.
